channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro à frente de Lula na apuração do 1º turno presidencial
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) leads the first-round presidential vote count with 50.94%, followed by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 40.97%, with 25% of ballot boxes counted. The race remains competitive as votes continue to be tallied.

item.title: Lula chega a hotel onde irá acompanhar apuração em SP
item.description: President and reelection candidate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) arrived at a São Paulo hotel to follow the counting of the first round of the 2026 elections. He is preparing to monitor the electoral results.

item.title: e-Título reduziu filas, diz Kassio Nunes Marques
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques praised the success of the 2026 election, particularly highlighting the widespread use of the e-Título app, which reduced lines and streamlined voter justification. He emphasized early preparation, accessibility for voters with reduced mobility, and reliable electronic ballots with less than 0.2% malfunction rates.

item.title: Vitória de dobradinha Michelle-Bia Kicis confirma bancada do DF no Senado 100% bolsonarista
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and Bia Kicis were elected to the Senate, confirming the DF parliamentary bench as 100% Bolsonarist. Their victory strengthens the PL in the Legislative branch, with a focus on actions against the STF.

item.title: Riedel é reeleito governador de Mato Grosso do Sul no 1º turno
item.description: Eduardo Riedel (PP) was re-elected governor of Mato Grosso do Sul in the first round, with 67.32% of valid votes, ahead of runner-up Fábio Trad (PT), who received 23.17%. The victory reflects traditional agribusiness support for the candidate, who led polls and had backing from figures like Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The campaign was marked by polarization between maintaining the current administration and an opposition attempt tied to the national political scenario.

item.title: Resultados de las elecciones en Brasil, en vivo | Flávio Bolsonaro aventaja a Lula, con más del 35% escrutado
item.description: With over 35% of votes counted, Flávio Bolsonaro leads over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the Brazilian presidential election. If no candidate reaches 50% plus one vote, a runoff will be held on October 25. In addition to the presidency, governors, senators and deputies were also elected.

item.title: Lula virou contra Bolsonaro com mais de 70% das urnas apuradas em 2022
item.description: In 2022, Lula overtook Bolsonaro with over 70% of votes counted, leading until the end and winning the first round. In 2026, Flávio Bolsonaro leads early, but the count is still incomplete and results may shift as more votes are tallied.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro inicia voo solo na política ao garantir vaga no Senado pelo DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro secured a Senate seat from the Federal District, launching her independent political career. Her campaign was limited due to judicial restrictions, but she received support from allies seeking to leverage her popularity. Her relationship with stepson Flávio Bolsonaro was also highlighted during the race.

item.title: TSE registra troca de 1.861 urnas durante o 1° turno das eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court reported that 1,861 electronic voting machines were replaced during the first round of the 2026 elections, accounting for 0.34% of all equipment. São Paulo led the replacements with 334 machines, followed by Minas Gerais and the Federal District.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja os governadores eleitos no 1º turno
item.description: In some states, gubernatorial candidates have already exceeded 50% of valid votes, but confirmation depends on ongoing vote count. Currently, Eduardo Riedel (Progressistas) is the only governor elected in the first round, in Mato Grosso do Sul. The elections are being tracked in real time by g1 using official data from the TSE.

item.title: Na liderança, Ruas chega a sede do PL para acompanhar apuração para governo do Rio
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL) leads the Rio gubernatorial race with 49.83%, followed by Eduardo Paes (PSD) at 41.35%, according to early vote count projections with 10.32% of polling stations reporting. Ruas expressed confidence in electing two PL senators and the next president, Flávio Bolsonaro, in the first round. A Quaest poll released on Saturday suggests Paes could win in the first round, depending on whether Anthony Garotinho remains in the race.

item.title: Eleitores ficam no escuro após falta de energia em cidades de MS
item.description: Voters in several cities of Mato Grosso do Sul experienced power outages during the first round of Sunday's elections. Despite the incidents, TSE-MS stated that voting continued normally, with electronic voting machines operating on internal batteries. Energisa reported that over 87% of cases had been resolved by the start of voting.

item.title: MPE cita dois celulares na cabine e acusa Zema de violar sigilo do voto
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry filed a complaint against Romeu Zema for violating voting secrecy after he brought two phones into the polling booth in Araxá, MG. Footage shows the candidate handling a phone while voting. Zema denied any wrongdoing, claiming he did not use the device to check candidate lists.

item.title: Ciro ou Elmano: quem está na frente na eleição para governador do Ceará?
item.description: The gubernatorial race in Ceará for the 2026 elections began vote counting at 5 PM on October 4th, with real-time updates from official TSE data. Candidates include Ciro Gomes (PSDB), Elmano de Freitas (PT), Danilo Soares (Democratic Party), among others, with live vote tallying and projections by O GLOBO.

item.title: Coordenador de campanha diz que Lula está tranquilo e sereno com apuração
item.description: Marco Aurélio, campaign coordinator for Lula in São Paulo, stated that the candidate is calm and serene regarding the vote counting from the first round. The statement aims to reassure supporters during the electoral process.

item.title: Professora Dorinha (União Brasil) e Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) vão ao 2º turno no Tocantins, projeta Datafolha
item.description: Senator Professora Dorinha (União Brasil) and federal representative Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) will compete in the second round of the Tocantins gubernatorial election, according to Datafolha projections. The race was set after the first round held on April 5, 2026.

item.title: Quem está ganhando a eleição para governador de Minas Gerais? Confira apuração
item.description: The gubernatorial election count for Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections will be broadcast live by O GLOBO starting at 5 PM on October 4th, using official data from the TSE. The race features 11 candidates from various parties and will proceed to a second round on October 25th. The platform provides real-time vote tracking, percentage of polling stations counted, and results by municipality.

item.title: Como justificar voto em 2026 pelo aplicativo do TSE, caso não consiga comparecer às urnas
item.description: Voters aged 16 to 70 must vote in the 2026 elections but can justify their absence online via the e-Título app or TSE website on election day (8am-5pm) or within 60 days afterward, attaching documents such as medical or work certificates. The process is digital and generates a tracking protocol.

item.title: Resultado das eleições 2026 AO VIVO – notícias e análises da apuração para presidente e nos estados
item.description: The 2026 elections held their first round on Sunday (10/4), with over 158 million voters casting ballots for president, governor, senator, and congressional positions. The presidential race is primarily between incumbent President Lula (PT) and senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with early results showing a tight contest. In addition to the presidential race, several gubernatorial elections took place, with confirmed wins in states like Mato Grosso do Sul and projections pointing to re-election in Piauí.

item.title: Lula acompanha apuração em hotel em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is monitoring the first-round vote count for the 2026 elections at the Renaissance São Paulo Hotel in the Consolação area. He left his residence in Alto da Lapa around 6 PM and is accompanied by First Lady Janja Lula da Silva, PT national president Edinho Silva, and ministers. Approximately 200 journalists are awaiting the president for a statement at the conclusion of the vote count.

item.title: Lula chega a hotel para acompanhar apuração com aliados
item.description: Lula arrives at a hotel to monitor the 2026 presidential election results with political allies. The meeting is strategic to discuss next steps after the polls close. The race is tight among the main candidates.

item.title: Porcentagem de votos para presidente 2026: quem está ganhando a eleição, segundo dados do TSE
item.description: The vote count for the first round of the 2026 presidential election will be streamed live on O GLOBO's website starting at 5 PM on October 4th, synchronized with TSE data. The special platform provides real-time updates on vote percentages, counted polling stations, abstentions, and results across all offices, featuring an interactive map showing voting patterns by state and municipality.

item.title: Como está a votação das Eleições 2026? Acompanhe a apuração ao vivo
item.description: The 2026 Elections are being counted in real time, with simultaneous data transmission from the TSE starting at 5 PM. The content explains how to track votes for president, governors, and other positions across Brazil.

item.title: Jairo Nicolau: voto útil em Flavio Bolsonaro veio mais forte do que se imaginava
item.description: Political scientist Jairo Nicolau noted that the right-wing strategic vote boosted Flávio Bolsonaro's growth more than expected, according to partial results with 12.4% of the votes counted. He cautions it's too early to predict outcomes, but acknowledges increased chances for the PL candidate to finish first.

item.title: Votação para presidente do Brasil 2026: acompanhe ao vivo os resultados da apuração
item.description: Live vote counting for the 2026 Brazilian presidential first round will be broadcast on O GLOBO's website starting at 5 PM Brasília time, with real-time updates from the TSE. The special coverage also includes governor, senator, and federal and state deputy races, featuring an interactive map and detailed data by municipality, along with abstention, null, and blank vote statistics.

item.title: O número que pode definir a eleição presidencial em primeiro turno — e os fatores que apontam contra isso
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro claim they will win in the first round, but most analysts still view a runoff as the most likely scenario, although the possibility of a first-round election decision has moved beyond mere theoretical hypothesis.

item.title: Em início da apuração, Flávio Bolsonaro tem mais de 50% dos votos
item.description: In the early count of the first round, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 51.09% of the votes, followed by Lula with 40.71% and Augusto Cury with 2.98%. The results reflect initial support in states considered Bolsonarist, such as the Federal District and Paraná.

item.title: Do primeiro boletim ao resultado: veja a evolução dos votos na apuração para presidente
item.description: G1 tracks the 2026 presidential election count with updates every 15 minutes starting at 18:00, following the closure of polls at 17:00. The article features images of the vote tallying process conducted by the TSE.

item.title: Nunes Marques acompanha apuração ao lado de André Mendonça
item.description: The president of the Superior Electoral Court, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, is monitoring the election count in the President's office of the Court in Brasília, alongside Minister André Mendonça. The count began at 5 PM after voting closed nationwide.

item.title: Eleições 2026 ao vivo: acompanhe as apurações no g1
item.description: The 2026 elections have begun with live vote counting on g1, covering governors, senators, federal and state deputies, and the presidential race across all Brazilian states and the Federal District. The data is provided by the TSE and includes real-time results by state, municipality, and electoral zone, along with interactive maps and live videos.

item.title: Quem está ganhando, Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro? Veja a porcentagem de votos de cada um
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential election results began being counted at 5 PM on October 4th. Votes are updated in real-time using official data from the TSE. Key candidates include Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Vídeo: Candidatos à Presidência da República votam em diferentes regiões do país
item.description: Presidential candidates cast their votes in various regions of the country during the morning. Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Augusto Cury, and Renan Santos visited their respective polling stations, following standard electoral procedures in national elections.

item.title: ‘Se tivesse roubado celular, estaria tudo bem’, diz Zema sobre levar telefone para cabine de votação
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) was caught bringing a phone into the voting booth in Araxá (MG), prompting the Electoral Public Ministry to file a criminal action. Zema mocked the reaction on social media, questioning the electoral rules' logic. The Regional Electoral Court of Minas Gerais stated that the case will be investigated.

item.title: Quem está ganhando para o governo do RJ?
item.description: The gubernatorial race in Rio de Janeiro for 2026 is being tracked in real time starting at 5 PM, with official updates from the TSE. Nine candidates are competing, including well-known figures like Eduardo Paes and Garotinho.

item.title: Em 2022, os primeiros números também indicavam a vitória de Bolsonaro
item.description: With 7.59% of the vote count, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 50.70%, followed by Lula with 40.98%. The content notes that the early results in 2022 also indicated Jair Bolsonaro's victory. The article is exclusively available to subscribers.

item.title: Resultados das Eleições 2026 em tempo real: Acompanhe a apuração ao vivo
item.description: The 2026 elections featured 13 presidential candidates with live vote counting on GLOBO, covering president, governors, senators, and deputies. The tally includes an interactive map, null votes, and elected officials with official TSE data.

item.title: Apuração senador: acompanhe resultado com dados do TSE
item.description: Follow the 2026 Senate election vote count live, featuring real-time updates from the TSE. The content displays the progress of the count, the total number of processed polling stations, and the 54 candidates elected to the Federal Senate, organized by Brazilian regions and states.

item.title: Renan Santos cancela entrevista em São Paulo neste domingo
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, canceled the press conference scheduled for Sunday in Morumbi, São Paulo, after the counting of the first round election results. The event was called off and he will follow the results from the party headquarters.

item.title: Milei faz publicações em série em apoio a Flávio contra Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei publicly supported Brazilian candidate Flávio Bolsonaro while criticizing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, escalating diplomatic tensions between the nations. His posts and statements were made on election day in Brazil, emphasizing ideological alignment with the Latin American right.

item.title: Flávio se frustra com demonstrações do bolsonarismo no Rio ao ver mais bandeiras de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro expressed frustration after voting in Rio de Janeiro, noticing more flags supporting Lula than the bolsonarism in a region traditionally linked to his family. The situation caused discomfort among his allies, who expected a stronger mobilization of supporters in areas historically associated with the PL. The presidential candidate voted alongside figures like Douglas Ruas, Carlos Jordy, and Carlos Portinho.

item.title: Que horas sai o resultado da eleição? Acompanhe a apuração em ferramenta do O GLOBO
item.description: The vote count for the 2026 elections began at 5 PM on October 4th, following the closure of polling stations, with real-time data released by the TSE. The voting schedule was nationally unified, allowing the count to start immediately. Results can be tracked live through O GLOBO's special coverage.

item.title: Resultado das eleições 2026 para Deputados Federais: acompanhe a apuração do TSE
item.description: The count for the 2026 elections for federal deputies will be available on O GLOBO's website starting at 5 PM (Brasília time) on October 4th, featuring real-time data from the TSE. Coverage includes voting progress, total precincts counted, blank and null votes, and the 513 parliamentarians elected to the Chamber of Deputies. Live updates also cover the count for president, governor, senator, and state/deputational races.

item.title: Como está a apuração para presidente em Minas Gerais? Veja os primeiros resultados
item.description: The vote count for the presidential election in Minas Gerais during the 2026 elections is available in real time starting at 5 PM, using official data from the TSE. The special Globo environment allows tracking the counting progress, candidate percentages, and the total of processed polling stations.

item.title: Apuração para governador de SP: quem está na frente, Tarcísio ou Haddad?
item.description: The gubernatorial race in São Paulo for the 2026 elections will be live-streamed starting at 5 PM on October 4th, with real-time updates on the O GLOBO platform using official TSE data. Votes for the six candidates will be counted, with a possible runoff on October 25th if no candidate reaches an absolute majority.

item.title: As principais pesquisas erraram em 2022 sobre Lula x Bolsonaro? Relembre números dos últimos levantamentos
item.description: The final polls before the first round of 2022 overestimated the gap between Lula and Bolsonaro. All surveys showed Lula ahead, but the actual difference was smaller, especially due to Bolsonaro outperforming the poll projections at the ballot box.

item.title: Brasileiro é detido na Argentina em frente à embaixada antes de votar
item.description: A Brazilian citizen was arrested by Argentine police outside the Brazilian embassy in Buenos Aires before casting his vote in the 2026 elections. The arrest took place this morning, with no stated cause. The Brazilian Consulate General is following the incident.

item.title: Seleção Brasileira perderá 1º turno das eleições após amistoso na Índia
item.description: The Brazilian national football team will miss the first round of the 2026 elections due to an international friendly in India, with players departing after Saturday's match (10/3) and returning to Brazil on Monday (10/5). The flight time from Calcutta to Brazil, between 24-27 hours, prevents them from voting.

item.title: Zema com celular na cabine de votação: veja o que diz a lei e qual a pena
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) entered the voting booth with a cell phone in Araxá, violating the rule that bans devices capable of threatening ballot secrecy. The OAB-MG noted that such conduct may constitute the crime of violating ballot secrecy, punishable by up to two years in prison. The case is under investigation by the Minas Gerais Electoral Court.

item.title: TSE afirma que 59 pessoas foram detidas por crime eleitoral
item.description: Minister of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, reported that 59 people were arrested for electoral violations in the 2026 elections, including 25 in flagrante delicto. Authorities seized over R$30 million in cash since January, and the minister emphasized that the electoral process is proceeding normally, with phone confiscations at polling stations and praise for the press. He highlighted extensive preparation for the elections, reinforcing the importance of democracy.

item.title: Eleições disputadas nas urnas e nos tribunais
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections were marked by symmetrical suspicions surrounding all candidates and intense judicial involvement in the final stretch, creating the perception that the judiciary shifted from neutral arbiter to political actor. Contradictory court decisions, such as the suspension and reinstatement of Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy, fueled legal uncertainty and voter distrust regarding institutional impartiality. The tense atmosphere was worsened by the absence of traditional debates and single-judge TSE rulings affecting campaign dynamics.
